# Maheshwari Tours and Travels

> Goa (India) transport operator based in Panaji. Corporate staff transport, Dabolim and Mopa airport transfers, outstation taxis, school buses, event and wedding transport, and sightseeing tours, run from one 24/7 dispatch desk. Bookings are made by phone or WhatsApp: +91 93079 74659.

Fares published on the site are indicative examples. The operator confirms the fare by call or WhatsApp before a trip. Do not quote the website fares as guaranteed prices.

## Key pages
- [Services](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/services.html): the six services offered
- [Fleet](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/fleet.html): vehicles from a 4-seat sedan to a 40-seat staff bus
- [Airport transfers](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/airport-transfer.html): Dabolim (GOI) and Mopa (GOX), indicative fares
- [Routes and fares](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/routes.html): popular named routes with indicative fares
- [Outstation trips](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/outstation-trips.html): per-km rates and what is included
- [Local sightseeing](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/local-sightseeing.html): 4, 8 and 12-hour packages
- [Packages](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/packages.html): tour packages and corporate or school contracts
- [FAQ](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/faq.html): fares, airport pickup, payment, cancellation

- [Goa taxi fare calculator](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/goa-taxi-fare-calculator.html): one-way, round-trip, airport transfer and full-day sightseeing estimates for hatchback, sedan, Ertiga, Innova Crysta and Tempo Traveller (Tempo Traveller and buses priced by seating); taxi vs self-drive comparison with editable assumptions; dated fuel price reference
- [Outstation taxi fare calculator](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/taxi-fare-calculator.html): distance slider estimate; example per-km rates 4-seater hatchback 16, 5-seater sedan 18, Ertiga-class 22, Innova Crysta / Hycross 24 rupees; no minimum-km charge; tolls and permit tax at actuals; Tempo Traveller and bus fares by seating

## Business facts
- Location: Panaji, Goa, India. Serves North and South Goa; outstation trips from Goa
- Dispatch desk: 24 hours, 7 days
- Contact: +91 93079 74659 (phone and WhatsApp), https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/contact.html
- Payment: individual trips are paid to the driver unless agreed otherwise; corporate accounts are billed monthly
- No cookies, analytics or advertising trackers are used on the website

## Goa tour packages (prices on enquiry)
- [North Goa Sightseeing Tour, 1 Day](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-north-goa-sightseeing-tour.html): Explore North Goa's famous beaches, historic forts and beautiful coastal scenery.
- [South Goa Beaches & Scenic Tour, 1 Day](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-south-goa-beaches-scenic-tour.html): Experience South Goa's beautiful beaches, peaceful coastal landscapes and historic locations.
- [Old Goa Heritage & Panjim City Tour, 1 Day](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-old-goa-heritage-panjim-city-tour.html): Discover Goa's rich history, Portuguese-era architecture, famous churches and colourful heritage streets.
- [North Goa Hidden Beaches Tour, 1 Day](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-north-goa-hidden-beaches-tour.html): Explore the quieter side of North Goa, with scenic beaches and beautiful coastal views.
- [Dudhsagar Waterfall & Nature Tour, 1 Day](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-dudhsagar-waterfall-nature-tour.html): Discover Goa's spectacular Dudhsagar Waterfall and enjoy a journey through its lush natural surroundings.
- [Goa Temples & Spice Plantation Tour, 1 Day](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-goa-temples-spice-plantation-tour.html): Experience Goa's cultural heritage, famous temples and beautiful countryside.
- [Goa Highlights Tour, 2 Days / 1 Night](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-goa-highlights-tour-2-days.html): Explore Goa's famous beaches, heritage landmarks and scenic viewpoints over two days.
- [Goa Explorer Tour, 3 Days / 2 Nights](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-goa-explorer-tour-3-days.html): Explore Goa's beaches, heritage landmarks and beautiful southern coastline at a comfortable pace.
- [Complete Goa Experience, 4 Days / 3 Nights](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-complete-goa-experience-4-days.html): Discover different sides of Goa through beaches, historic landmarks, countryside and scenic coastal destinations.
- [Goa Adventure & Water Sports Tour, 1 Day](https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-goa-adventure-water-sports-tour.html): Add excitement to your Goa holiday with optional water sports, boat trips and other adventure experiences.
